name: Native character-advancement requests switch specializations, keep stored builds and reset talents
contract: The original client changes talents only through Extensions.dll packets. SwitchActiveChrSpec plus ApplyPendingBuild uploads CMSG 0x0727 holding the class tree, the new ChrSpecs identity entry (+0x70) and its signature entry (+0x60); UnlearnAllTalents sends CMSG_UNLEARN_TALENTS (0x0213). A Bloodmage (class 20) at level 80 enters Eternal (ChrSpecs 99), buys Rotclaw (entry 30191, spell 804197, one specialization point), switches to Sanguine (26) and back. Expected: leaving Eternal removes Rotclaw and stores it, returning restores it, and the native reset removes every paid rank while Eternal stays active (player setting core.ascension_active_spec).

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Returning to Eternal restores its stored Rotclaw
The native reset keeps Eternal active
